messages:
Sam P: Hey team — customer (acct: ACCT-933) flagged that their invoice for Feb shows ~18k embedding units but their dashboard shows ~4.2k. Can we triage?
Support-bot: New support case created: CASE-2026-5587. Added billing logs and raw request IDs.
Finance Ops: Thanks, Sam. Can you paste the invoice ID and a couple of request IDs so we can map charges?
Sam P: Invoice INV-9204-02, sample req ids: req_8f3a, req_8f3b, req_8f4c. Customer's integration sends mixed-size batches from their worker pool (sometimes 1 large doc + many small). They reported one call returning 512-dim vectors as expected, but the meter shows extra units.
Aisha R: Quick hypothesis: batch splitter or async path may be splitting a single logical request into N sub-requests and the billing pipeline is counting per-subrequest rather than per-input. Also check truncation fallback — if we pad/truncate vectors to different dims we might be double-counting pairwise rerank multipliers.
Maya S: I pulled the serving trace for req_8f3a — runtime logs show the request was split into 3 internal batches due to a single item hitting the max-token threshold, then enqueued on the async batcher.
Jorge C: Runtime note: when an input is truncated we currently create a synthetic request id for the truncated shard to re-use KV caches. The billing record emits at the shard level right now. That would cause inflated counts if we don't reconcile back to the original client inputs.
Finance Ops: If that's the case we need a reconciliation script ASAP and a credit while we investigate. Do we have a quick repro?
Sam P: I can repro locally using their payload. Example curl they used:

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-xxl","inputs":["short1","short2","<very long document...>","short3","short4"],"batch_size":128,"truncate":"auto"}'

When I run it I see 1 client request -> 3 internal shards in /runtime/batcher logs. The metering pipeline shows 5 embedding units (should be 5 inputs), but invoice shows 15.
Aisha R: Can you attach full request bodies + the runtime shard ids? Also send any HTTP response headers X-Request-Id and X-Billing-Trace that arrived back from the API.
Sam P: Attached in CASE-2026-5587 (payloads + X-Request-Id mapping).
Maya S: From infra logs: billing-emitter consumed messages keyed by internal_shard_id. There is no upstream mapping to original_request_id in the emitted record.
Jorge C: Proposed short-term fix: emit original_request_id and original_input_count in the billing event so the downstream invoice aggregation groups by original request. Long-term: change shard accounting to include a de-dup/token attribution layer that maps shards -> original inputs before applying rerank pairwise multipliers.
Finance Ops: Ok. Please estimate how long to roll the hotfix and whether we can retroactively reconcile past invoices for affected months (we need a list of affected invoices).
Aisha R: Hotfix to include original_request_id in billing events is a ~1-day patch + pipeline deploy. Reconciliation script to collapse shard records back to original_request_id is ~2 days to run and validate.
Sam P: Customer asked if we can proactively credit the delta while we run reconciliation.
Finance Ops: Approving a provisional credit for INV-9204-02 for the delta between dashboard (4,200) and billed (18,000). Please add a note to CASE-2026-5587 and include the reconciliation ticket ID once created.
Jorge C: I'll push a minimal change to include original_request_id in events and a flag to opt-in to aggregated counting (feature gate) so we can test without touching all tenants.
Maya S: Test plan: replay 1k sample requests with mixed-size inputs and assert invoice-level counts == dashboard aggregated counts. I'll run this in staging.
Sam P: Thanks — looping in the customer: "we've opened an internal fix and will credit your invoice; we'll follow up with a reconciliation report in 48-72h."
Finance Ops: Filed internal ticket BILL-RECON-2026-11 and granted provisional credit.
Support-bot: CASE-2026-5587 updated: assigned to eng-runtime, eng-ml, finance; priority: P2.
Sam P: Great, please keep me posted. :thumbsup:
Aisha R: Follow-up note: check rerank/pairwise paths too — pairwise calls multiply counted inputs by N^2 in some shard-level summaries. Adding pairwise unit tests to prevent regression.
Jorge C: Ack, will add tests and a few alerting rules if invoice vs dashboard delta > 20% for a single account.
Finance Ops: Closing provisional action item: will wait for reconciliation output before final settlement.
Sam P: Closing thread for now, moving details into CASE-2026-5587 and BILL-RECON-2026-11."
